verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a documented system-to-system REST API with a get-started guide, Authorisation and rate-limiting guides, and a key-based auth model. A probe confirms the live API returns a structured auth challenge to unauthenticated calls. However, the documented channel only retrieves register data; filing is shown only as a web service for people replacing paper forms, so software cannot be shown to transact with the register. Missing for 10: a documented software-filing channel (system accounts or presenter/transmitter programs for submissions), a batch/bulk provider program, an explicitly published enrollment path for filing software, and independent corroboration.
